VT-0001.name: Fat Sheep Farm & Cabins
VT-0001.description: Five private cabins on a working farm in Hartland, with hill views, farm activities and family stays.
VT-0001.capacityDetails: Five cabins; occupancy varies by cabin. Sunrise has a queen bedroom and a living-room futon; no explicit maximum on the checked page.
VT-0001.kidsDetails: Children welcome; adult supervision required on the working farm. Sunrise page says children aged two and under stay free.
VT-0001.petsDetails: Dogs only in Sunrise, Ascutney and Lull Brook cabins, on the reservation and leashed. Sunrise pet cleaning fee: $30/night per pet.
VT-0001.priceDetails: Rates vary by date and cabin. Sunrise page lists a $55 one-time cleaning fee, $30/night for additional guests beyond two, and typical two-night weekend/three-night holiday minimums.
VT-0001.bookingMethod: Direct ThinkReservations booking, phone, email and contact form

address.notes: Official site explicitly says to use Windsor for mailing, rather than Hartland. Physical location is Hartland.

VT-0001.notes: Small working-farm operator, not an aggregator. Separate cabins need unit-specific policies and capacity. Genuine photo set shows Sunrise Cabin.

VT-0003.name: Lakeshore Vermont Inn & Suites
VT-0003.description: Locally owned lakefront suites and cottages in Colchester, with private beaches, kitchens and access to Lake Champlain.
VT-0003.capacityDetails: Multiple distinct rentals. Homepage lists two-person suites/cottages and a four-person Vermonter suite; capacities differ by unit.
VT-0003.kidsDetails: Family-oriented accommodation in the official tourism listing; property website describes family stays.
VT-0003.petsDetails: Homepage identifies pet-friendly accommodation. Confirm the chosen unit's policy and fees.
VT-0003.bookingMethod: Direct ThinkReservations booking, telephone and operator email

address.type: Main office and some accommodation units; operator has multiple addresses
address.notes: Contact page distinguishes units at 76, 54 and 38 West Lakeshore Drive. A Burlington unit is at 65 North Union Street. Do not assign the main office address to every rental.

VT-0003.notes: Locally owned operator, not an aggregator. Selected cover shows Lakeside Villa only; other units must receive their own photos and addresses.

VT-0005.name: The Cobble House
VT-0005.description: A restored Victorian vacation house above the White River in Gaysville, sleeping ten in five en suite bedrooms.
VT-0005.capacityDetails: Sleeps 10 in five en suite bedrooms, as stated on the homepage.
VT-0005.kidsDetails: The expanded Stay-page FAQ explicitly welcomes children.
VT-0005.petsDetails: Expanded Stay-page FAQ says pets are by arrangement; contact the operator at 802-216-8866.
VT-0005.bookingMethod: Operator inquiry form, telephone and direct email; Book a Stay page linked

address.notes: Contact page separately labels PO Box 49 as the postal address. Gaysville is the published village label.

VT-0005.notes: Whole vacation house and private event venue. Bath count and total rooms not inferred from the five en suite bedrooms.

VT-0008.name: Hobble Inn & The Loft
VT-0008.description: A three-bedroom vacation house and a separate one-bedroom loft in Stowe village, offered for weekly and longer stays.
VT-0008.capacityDetails: Hobble Inn: three bedrooms, sleeps six, two bathrooms. The separate Loft has one bedroom; its maximum needs checking.
VT-0008.kidsDetails: Official homepage offers the Inn for families and small groups.
VT-0008.bookingMethod: Direct inquiry to named owner Mary Skelton Altadonna by email, phone or contact form; booking links lead to Red Cottage

address.notes: Official contact page gives street and town but no ZIP. The Inn and Loft are separate accommodations.

VT-0008.notes: Independent owner site with direct inquiry even though booking links lead to a manager. Keep Inn and Loft unit facts distinct. Selected photos show the Inn only, not the separate Loft.

VT-0009.name: Mount Snow Yurt
VT-0009.description: An insulated, yurt-shaped cabin near Mount Snow, with two private bedrooms, a loft, hot tub and cedar sauna.
VT-0009.capacityDetails: Maximum eight guests. Two private queen bedrooms, loft sleeper sofa and convertible living-room sofa; four sleeping spaces are not four bedrooms.
VT-0009.kidsDetails: Families welcome. Hot tub is prohibited for children under twelve; older minors require direct adult supervision.
VT-0009.petsDetails: Published FAQ welcomes well-behaved pets with a $100 fee per stay.
VT-0009.bookingMethod: Operator booking interface and direct inquiry email

address.notes: Homepage travel and contact sections publish the full address. Tourism directory calls the area West Dover.

VT-0009.notes: Solid-construction cabin in a yurt shape. Advertised sleeping spaces and bedroom counts kept distinct.

VT-0010.name: Quimby Country Lodge & Cottages
VT-0010.description: A traditional sporting camp in Averill with nineteen lakeside cottages, a lodge and family vacation programs.
VT-0010.capacityDetails: Nineteen cottages, with checked published cabin capacities from one to eight depending on the cottage. Silver Sedge sleeps four to eight.
VT-0010.kidsDetails: Official site explicitly offers family holidays and children's activities.
VT-0010.bookingMethod: Operator reservations page, contact form, telephone and direct email

address.notes: Full address appears on the official contact page and homepage.

VT-0010.notes: Distinct from Quimby Cottage names elsewhere. Some cottage illustrations on the site are paintings; selected assets are photographs, subject to visual review. Selected photo set shows Brown Hackle Cabin.

VT-0012.name: Notch Lodges
VT-0012.description: Five family-owned chalet and cabin rentals near Smugglers' Notch, with direct booking and dog-friendly stays.
VT-0012.capacityDetails: Five distinct rentals sleep four to six guests each. Blue Jay's Blue Chalet sleeps four; Charming Vermont Log Cabin sleeps six.
VT-0012.kidsDetails: Blue Jay's Blue Chalet welcomes children but is not suitable for infants; steep loft stairs. Check other units separately.
VT-0012.petsDetails: Official homepage offers dog-friendly chalets with no pet fee.
VT-0012.bookingMethod: Operator booking/availability pages, direct email and telephone

address.type: Tourism-listed operator address; individual chalet addresses not established
address.notes: Official About and Blue Jay pages were checked, but only Jeffersonville was published on those pages. The street remains directory evidence, not a verified address for every chalet.

VT-0012.notes: Owners Maude and Marc describe five owned properties. Blue Jay's page advertises $155–240/night; that range is unit-specific, not an operator-wide price. Selected cover shows Blue Jay's Blue Chalet only. Other units require distinct image sets.

VT-0053.name: Robert Frost Mountain Cabins
VT-0053.description: Seven timber-frame cabins in Ripton, with full kitchens, screened porches and woodland access in the Green Mountains.
VT-0053.capacityDetails: Official homepage states each of the seven cabins sleeps up to six guests.
VT-0053.petsDetails: Official cabin list identifies Serene Outlook, Owl's Branch and Hemlock Hideaway as pet-friendly. Confirm current unit rules and fees.
VT-0053.priceDetails: Checked cabin-list page displayed From $237/night without selected dates. Rates and availability depend on the chosen stay.
VT-0053.bookingMethod: Direct ThinkReservations-powered cabin search, operator email and telephone

address.notes: Official directions and contact information publish the physical address.

VT-0053.notes: Cabin photographs selected from the operator's accommodation list; unrelated decorative logos excluded. Selected cover shows the first listed cabin, Peak Perspective; no cross-unit photo set is assigned.
